title: Private Boston Movie Mile Guided Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This tour takes place in all weather conditions
There are several quick step-off points at some of the locations during the tour
This is a walking tour, so wear comfortable walking shoes
Maximum of 35 people per group tour departure
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Tour the Boston Common and Beacon Hill areas and visit more than 30 movie locations on this captivating private movie and TV walking tour! This tour is a must for film buffs, and is also a great way to explore Boston and its many attractions. On this Boston walking tour, your guide, a local actor, will provide a unique sightseeing tour with an entertaining twist!
